text:
I can't know from a single "before" photo how much will be left over, so the leftover figure is a guess. I assumed the person eats most of the meal.

Estimated energy and macros for the items served:
- Two fried eggs: about 180 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbohydrate, 14 g fat.
- Banana, medium: about 105 kcal, 1 g protein, 27 g carbohydrate, 0 g fat.
- Strawberries, about 1/2 cup: about 25 kcal, 0.5 g protein, 6 g carbohydrate, 0 g fat.
- Yogurt cup, about 100 g: about 60 kcal, 3 g protein, 10 g carbohydrate, 1 g fat.
- Orange juice, about 180 ml: about 80 kcal, 1 g protein, 19 g carbohydrate, 0 g fat.
- Latte or coffee with milk: about 80 kcal, 4 g protein, 6 g carbohydrate, 4 g fat.

Together the served meal is about 530 kcal.

I assumed about 40 kcal is left over, for example some of the coffee or part of the eggs. That leaves about 490 kcal eaten, with roughly 20 g protein, 66 g carbohydrate and 17 g fat.
